title: Japanese Cornbread Casserole
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors and American cornbread, perfect for a comforting meal. This casserole combines the sweetness of corn with savory ingredients for a delightful taste experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, and cheese blend.
In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, scallions, pickled ginger, sesame oil, and egg.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
